title: 第19章 九滴精血
content_zh:
众多杂役弟子束手而立，静静听着王管事充斥着暴躁不耐的声音。

    “第一件事，清退灵田。”

    “最近几个月，灵田处又有两名杂役弟子出了事。一个是王富贵，五灵根资质，病老而死；他宗门功劳耗尽，只剩下一子一女。因为没有半点余泽给后人，这一子一女又没有灵根资质，不得留在万春谷内，驱赶出去，并收回灵田。”

    “另一个是凌慧，五灵根资质，私自离开灵田处两月不回，导致灵田荒芜，收回灵田，并由外门弟子接任务追查；若安分守己，不传功法，便只废去修为逐出门派，令她做凡人；若将功法传出，凡涉及之人一概诛杀。”

    念完这些之后，王管事满意地看到众人鸦雀无声的模样。

    “记住了，我们万春谷虽然宽宏大量，甚少征伐杀戮，却也不是平白开善堂的！你们这些杂役弟子修炼到外门或者专门用小功兑换，才能学习杀伐法术，正是为了你们安心种田与修炼，不要乱想其他！”

    “像是那王富贵，资质本来就差，赚些灵米便购买女人不思进取，一生不过练气二层，生下来子女受苦受难，自己也病老死去，这等不成器的东西，岂不可笑？”

    王管事为人虽然不好，但是这话还真有几分道理。

    杂役弟子们不安心修行，去找什么女人享受，这就等于把本来就艰难的修行道路自己给断了。

    叱喝一阵之后，王管事又说道：“还有一件事，青禾坊市周围出现魔血门的魔修踪迹，内门弟子已经有亲自出手，接任务巡逻坊市的。”

    “以你们的微末修为，若是遇上魔血门的魔修必死无疑。所以你们不到万不得已不要再去青禾坊市，到时候就算遇不到魔血门的魔修，遇上咱们万春谷的内门弟子巡逻，把你们扣下了，我也不会领你们回来！”

    “到时候，是死是活，就看你们自己的运道吧！”

    韩榆听后，不动声色。

    在他身边的李老道身体微微紧绷，显然已经紧张起来。

    等到王管事不耐烦地宣布结束，并和其他两个外门弟子带着灵米离去之后，李老道、韩榆两人方才对视一眼。

    他们还来不及说话，已经被远近不同地方传来的哭喊声、抽泣声、以及欢喜交谈声音吸引。

    那王富贵的一子一女被驱赶出去万春谷显然很不甘心，跪在地上苦苦哀求，哭喊不断从远处传来，越来越远。

    刘兰刚刚突破练气三层不久，正满心欢喜，谁知道今年的灵米收获差了一些，居然全部被缴获，接下来的修炼资源都会变得紧迫，王管事一走，她就忍不住小声哭起来。

    这会儿，张山、孙康两人正在安慰她。
content_en:
Many handyman disciples stood with their hands tied, listening quietly to Steward Wang's irritable and impatient voice.

"The first thing is to clear out the spiritual field."

"In recent months, something has happened to two other disciples in the Lingtian Department. One is Wang Fugui, who has five spiritual roots. He died of old age. His sect's merits have been exhausted, leaving only a son and a daughter. Because there is nothing left for future generations, the son and the daughter have no spiritual roots. They are not allowed to stay in Wanchun Valley. They are driven out and the spiritual fields are taken back."

"The other one is Ling Hui, who has five spiritual roots. She left the spiritual field privately and did not return for two months, causing the spiritual field to become deserted. The spiritual field was taken back, and the outer disciples took over the task of tracing it. If she keeps to herself and does not teach the skills, she will be expelled from the sect and become a mortal. If the skills are spread, everyone involved will be killed."

After reading these words, Manager Wang was satisfied to see the silence among everyone.

"Remember, although our Wanchun Valley is magnanimous and rarely conscripts and kills, we do not open a charity hall for free! You, the handyman disciples, have to practice in the outer sect or use small skills to exchange for small skills to learn killing spells. It is just for you to farm and practice with peace of mind. Don't think about other things!"

"For example, Wang Fugui has poor qualifications. He earns some spiritual rice and buys women without any ambition. He can only reach the second level of Qi training in his life. His children will suffer after birth, and he himself will get sick and die. Isn't it ridiculous that such useless things are useless?"

Although Guanshi Wang is not a good person, there is some truth in what he said.

The handyman disciples don't feel at ease to practice and find women to enjoy themselves. This is tantamount to cutting off the already difficult path of practice.

After scolding for a while, Manager Wang added: "One more thing, there are traces of demon cultivators from the Demonic Blood Sect around Qinghefang City. Some of the inner disciples have personally taken action to patrol the city."

"With your low level of cultivation, you will definitely die if you encounter the demonic cultivators of the Demonic Blood Sect. Therefore, you should not go to Qinghefang City again unless you have to. Even if you don't meet the demonic cultivators of the Demonic Blood Sect by then, but if you encounter the inner disciples of our Wanchun Valley patrolling and detain you, I will not take you back!"

"When the time comes, whether you live or die depends on your own destiny!"

After hearing this, Han Yu remained calm.

Next to him, Li Laodao's body tensed slightly, and he was obviously nervous.

After Manager Wang impatiently announced the end and left with the other two outer disciples and Lingmi, Li Laodao and Han Yu looked at each other.

Before they could speak, they were already attracted by the sounds of crying, sobbing, and happy conversations coming from different places near and far.

Wang Fugui's son and daughter were obviously unwilling to be driven out of Wanchungu. They knelt on the ground and begged, and the cries kept coming from a distance, getting farther and farther.

Liu Lan had just broken through the third level of Qi training and was full of joy. Who knew that this year's harvest of spiritual rice was a little worse, and all of them were seized. The next cultivation resources would become urgent. As soon as Manager Wang left, she couldn't help crying softly.

At this moment, Zhang Shan and Sun Kang were comforting her.
title_en: Chapter 19 Nine Drops of Essence and Blood
